answer: Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a comet header. Replaying a stored transcript fails as the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a dawn spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Producing 15 answers an epoch hence burns 99 real forward passes, and the basalt record lets any auditor recompute the check. That is 33 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
